title: Concept: Test fixture with customer records published
description: A fixture file that carries realistic customer records in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Fixtures are copied from production often enough that they carry real identifiers, and they are served without any of the controls the customer API has.
applicability: Deployments that render a fixture file that carries realistic customer records into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Fixtures are copied from production often enough that they carry real identifiers, and they are served without any of the controls the customer API has.
